classification: tool admission and deterministic setup orchestration
scope: Source-level preparation composition; not packaged or live acceptance
positive: Repeated and concurrent preparation retains one created run across partial attachment failure.
Run budget comes from the exact browser-selected intent, not an MCP duration override.
Browser HTTP enqueue and authenticated MCP preparation share one mailbox in the transport fixture.
Existing production run APIs remain responsible for creation and durable idempotency; no continuation executor is introduced.
negative: Current candidate runs require explicit selection; preparation does not choose the first or newest.
Changed choices and foreign clients are rejected.
Presence loss after creation stops attachment while retaining the run for retry.
Preparation attachment refuses a previously revoked room binding in the pg-mem fixture.
limitations: Transport fixture injects account, room and run service ports; it is not live provider authentication.
Fresh verified presence publication after preparation remains a separate task operation.
Running EXE and current callable catalog have not been updated by this patch.
No CS1 closure, CS2-CS4 qualification, ET6 acceptance or NAV1 unlock.
